blurb: Amherst Golf Club is a historic 9-hole golf course established in 1900, designed by Walter Hatch and renovated by Geoffrey Cornish. The course measures 3,075 yards from back tees and 2,983 yards from forward tees, with a par of 35. The Clubhouse offers a pro shop, snack bar, and private lessons from PGA professionals.
extraNote: All guests and daily fee players must sign in at the Pro Shop before play · Only alcoholic beverages purchased in the Pro Shop may be consumed on the course · No fivesomes allowed without Pro's permission · Junior members not permitted in adult tournaments or weekend mornings unless with adult member · Pro Shop at Amherst Golf Club
